paragraphs: tag_string_general: 333 of 355 rows have known values (93.8% coverage).

At k = 50, mean shared-label agreement is 68.3% when weighting positive anchor–label pairs, and 68.3% when weighting labels equally. Mean individual label lift is 1.365 and equal-label lift is 1.366. Mean lift is not aggregate purity divided by aggregate chance.

day: 176 known positives; 176 evaluable positive anchors have 53.0% mean agreement, versus 52.9% reference prevalence (lift 1.003). An average of 47.11 of 50 neighbors have known annotations. Large lift for a rare label can coexist with low agreement.

palette_0: 168 known positives; 168 evaluable positive anchors have 100.0% mean agreement, versus 50.5% reference prevalence (lift 1.982). An average of 47.21 of 50 neighbors have known annotations. Large lift for a rare label can coexist with low agreement.

water: 167 known positives; 167 evaluable positive anchors have 54.2% mean agreement, versus 50.2% reference prevalence (lift 1.081). An average of 47.34 of 50 neighbors have known annotations. Large lift for a rare label can coexist with low agreement.
Known-neighbor coverage at this k is 94.3%. Unknown neighbors are excluded from agreement denominators; missing annotations can bias the result.

The saved null comparison gives an empirical one-sided p-value of 0.1667 for macro_lift. This tests the specified shuffle, not semantic understanding; use the combined multiple-testing table and practical effect sizes when judging the finding.
The probe panel measures recoverability on a held-out split. Compare each model with its baseline; recoverability and nearest-neighbor usefulness answer different questions.
baseline: balanced_accuracy 0.5, macro_f1 0.286; 84 held-out test rows (or the macro summary of supported binary tags).
linear: balanced_accuracy 0.7966, macro_f1 0.7887; 84 held-out test rows (or the macro summary of supported binary tags).

For paired_micro_purity at k = 50, A is 0.683 and B is 0.8363, with B−A 0.1533 across 333 paired anchors. Conditional 95% interval: 0.1476 to 0.1574; higher is better for this measure. This does not rank overall embedding quality.

Embedding A normalization comparison on identical held-out rows: raw_standardized: balanced_accuracy 0.7966, unit: balanced_accuracy 0.7643, unit_standardized: balanced_accuracy 0.777, norm_only: balanced_accuracy 0.4781. Direction-only and magnitude-only scores describe accessible information for these pipelines; fit telemetry does not establish encoder-training stability.

Embedding B normalization comparison on identical held-out rows: raw_standardized: balanced_accuracy 0.8778, unit: balanced_accuracy 0.8746, unit_standardized: balanced_accuracy 0.8778, norm_only: balanced_accuracy 0.5002.
